The Subtask Name: Identify the performer of the song "Fast Car" by Namie Amuro
Step Range: 0-1
The Oracle: Namie Amuro
Evidence: The user query explicitly states "Fast Car (Namie Amuro Song)", identifying Namie Amuro as the performer.

The Subtask Name: Retrieve the birthplace of Namie Amuro from search results
Step Range: 2-3
The Oracle: Naha, Okinawa, Japan
Evidence: WebSurfer searches "Namie Amuro birthplace" and finds multiple sources (DuckDuckGo, Bijog, BiographyPot) stating she was born in Naha, Okinawa, Japan.

The Subtask Name: Verify and extract the exact birthplace from the Wikipedia infobox
Step Range: 4-6

The Subtask Name: Corroborate birthplace with Britannica and finalize answer
Step Range: 7-9
The Oracle: Naha, Okinawa, Japan
Evidence: Planner instructs to open Britannica; WebSurfer is instructed to scroll and verify; Planner concludes the task with the final answer "Naha, Okinawa, Japan" citing Wikipedia and Britannica.
